title: Great tour!
text: Pedro was wonderful.  Picked us up at our hotel in a very clean car with water provided.  Guided us through Montserrat to be sure we saw everything and timed the visit so we could hear the beginning of a service.  He handled our tickets for us and gave us some souvenirs.  He was extremely personable and spoke English very well.  He is also fluent in French and Spanish.  I highly recommend this tour.
author: Nancy_T
